name: Pi Quota
description: Unified read-only quota monitor for Claude, Codex, Antigravity, and OpenCode (defaults to compact line surface).

Use /quota line for compact status, /quota box for expanded box, and /quota panel for full details.

postInstallInstructions: Set defaultBackground to false in ~/.pi/workflows/settings.json so omitted workflow calls run inline.

name: Codex Computer Use
description: Give Pi agents access to Codex's native macOS computer-use capabilities.
postInstallInstructions: Run `bash bin/install-codex-computer-use.sh` (or `python3 bin/codex-computer-use.py install`) to configure the Codex app-server bridge and verify readiness.
Ensure Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions are granted in macOS System Settings > Privacy & Security.
Run `bash bin/install-codex-computer-use.sh --doctor` or `/computer-use status` in Pi to verify status.

name: Jev & MCP Adapter
description: MCP adapter with support for Jev (System One) semantic tool discovery and fast decision gating.
postInstallInstructions: Run `bash bin/install-jev.sh` to install the Jev statusline extension and configure permissions.
Store your System One API key securely: `~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/.bin/pi-mcp-adapter key set systemone`.
Run `/mcp-adapter jev setup` in Pi to complete guided setup.

name: OpenAI Fast Mode
